content: {"reasoning": "The claim was already submitted clean 12 days ago and is well within timely filing; auth isn't required, COB order is correct, and no denial or info request is on the table, so appeals, retro-auth, corrections, and resubmission (duplicate risk) are all inappropriate. The open balance of $167.20 exactly equals the patient's remaining deductible with 0% coinsurance, meaning Medicare will apply this entirely to the deductible as patient responsibility (PR-1). Since this is the patient's contractual share and nothing more is expected from the primary payer, billing the patient is the correct progressing action.", "action": "bill_patient"}
